title: Mitten Blocks
blurb: A shared block table for VR and phone: build on your phone and it appears in the headset, build in VR and it appears on your phone. Live sync runs on the claude.ai page; this copy builds solo.
controls: Phone: tap to build/paint/erase, drag to spin, pinch to zoom. VR: point + trigger, panel on the left, right stick spins/lifts the table, left stick resizes it
